figures.name: overview
figures.title: Overview (`result.plot()`)
figures.shows: The figure that `result.plot()` saves: (a) clonal programmes on the clone map, (b) clonal coherence, (c) programme stability, (d) programme composition by `state`.

figures.name: coherence
figures.title: Clonal coherence
figures.shows: Share of transcriptional variance explained by clone identity (clonal ICC), observed and with clone labels shuffled within each `sample` (bar: mean of 200 permutations; whisker: their central 95 %).

figures.name: clone_map_programmes
figures.title: Clone map: programmes
figures.shows: The clone map (UMAP of clone profiles; one point per clone, area by its number of cells) coloured by clonal programme, one panel per programme, every other clone in grey.

figures.name: clone_map_clone_size
figures.title: Clone map: clone size
figures.shows: The clone map coloured by the number of cells of each clone.

figures.name: clone_map_reliability
figures.title: Clone map: profile reliability
figures.shows: The clone map coloured by the reliability of each clone's profile (0 to 1; it grows with the number of cells sampled from the clone).

figures.name: clone_map_state
figures.title: Clone map: state
figures.shows: The clone map coloured by `state`, the level held by at least half of each clone's cells, one panel per level, every other clone in grey (clones without such a majority appear only in grey).

figures.name: stability
figures.title: Programme stability
figures.shows: Bootstrap stability of each programme (mean Jaccard overlap with the best-matching group over 30 bootstrap replicates), with the 0.75 (stable) and 0.6 guides.

figures.name: composition_state_cells
figures.title: Programme composition: state (cells)
figures.shows: For each programme (one bar), the fraction of the programme's cells in each level of `state` (levels beyond the seventh pooled as 'other').

figures.name: composition_state_clones
figures.title: Programme composition: state (clones)
figures.shows: For each programme (one bar), the mean over the programme's clones of each clone's fraction of cells in each level of `state`, so that every clone counts once (levels beyond the seventh pooled as 'other').

figures.name: cells_programmes
figures.title: Cells: programmes
figures.shows: Cells on a UMAP of the embedding the run used (`X_published`): the cells of each programme's clones, one panel per programme, on the grey of all cells.

figures.name: cells_state
figures.title: Cells: state
figures.shows: Cells on a UMAP of the embedding the run used (`X_published`): the cells of each level of `state`, one panel per level, on the grey of all cells.
